turns.instruction:
Build and analyze the three-storey C35 frame using the supplied height schedule. The second storey height is entered as -3.3 m. Check the dimensions and identify any necessary correction before reporting results. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

The second storey height was a sign error: change only that height to +3.3 m. Rebuild the elevations as 3.3, 6.6 and 9.9 m. Keep C35, the 60 kN/m beam loads and the 30 kN load at the second-storey midpoint. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-storey rightmost beam-column joint, and global support My and Rz (=Fz) at the leftmost ground-level column base for every original load case and every listed combination, with signs and units.
